entry_points.text: Exit keeps low-8 status and never returns, group variant coordinates peers; native wait covers info and legacy PID/PGID/all with user publish where faults fail; compat preserves semantics with width-translated usage.
Fault debugfs offers inject control with list alias and inject file for arm/list, plus per-symbol value file; listing prints symbolic addrs; stale or mistyped updates rejected.

Final mm release refuses init mm, revokes lazy users, tears down sched/paging/id/notify/acct and validates drained; final task release requires exited zero-ref non-current; early fork init creates task slab, limits, namespace seeds and subsystem registration.

exports.text: Task and mm exe lookup return a new reference or null; task path skips kthreads and stabilizes mm, mm path uses read-side protection; dup propagates with write-deny and one-time warn.

Basic and extended accounting fill elapsed, birth, flags, sched, ids, creds, times, faults and command, plus memory-delay integrals, peak sampling and truncated IO with byte totals zeroed when untracked.
Peer kill clears stop state, queues unblockable termination to live peers and reports count; pidfd resolves a referenced pid with flags; weak abort always faults then halts.
Kernel text classifier accepts core text directly and module/trampoline/kprobe/BPF via oracles, extended variant adds init text; descriptor resolver delegates only inside op-desc range.
MM and task lifetime: create, final and async release, exe swap, cross-task access, ptrace check, and final task free to caches with arch and resource teardown.
Population accounting keeps monotonic fork total, live count with tunable bound, and per-CPU counters summed over possible CPUs.

hazards.text: Misuse diverts to warn/fault/halt: bad stop reason, exit from IRQ or idle, repeated-fault bound, weak abort, freeing init/current mm, task put with refs or unexited, early stack free which leaks, plus stack/shadow markers detect overflow.
Allocation, build, validate and user-export failures abort with error and release partial state: buffer/attr reserve, listener clone, option/id checks, copy of status/info/usage.
Text classification outside RCU watching must enter NMI-like watching around oracle consultation for traces, warnings and CPU transitions.

invariants.text: Stop/continue reports select tracer parent or group-leader real parent, carry namespaced ids plus times and reason/status; ignored SIGCHLD or no-stop disables queueing but waiter wakeup still runs.

Taskstats skips without family/listeners; single exit emits one record, group exit adds versioned aggregate; replies reserve space with per-CPU seq for broadcasts; send clones except last and prunes refused exclusively; fill clears/versions/composes; group store reused with single-winner race.
Memory-time integrals apply only to user tasks with mm after a tick elapsed, scaling RSS and virtual size with fixed downshift under masked interrupts.

Wait setup validates options/interests and resolves ALL/PID/PGID/PIDFD with group default and nonblock inheritance; thread-restricted wake adds direct-parent check; kernel wait is prepare/collect/put with no-progress nonblock mapped to retry.
Substitute values normalize by target type: null to 0, bool to 1, errno clamped to valid negative range else EINVAL; empty post handler blocks jump optimization.

Thread max derives from free memory over stack cost with safety divisor, clamped with overflow check; freed mm must show zero RSS/PT counts; dump filter parses boot int then shifts/masks; new mm inherits filter/defaults from current or globals.

New task resets coverage tracking and inherits handle, takes NUMA node from kthread daemon, skips inlined IPI mask; shadow release no-ops when disabled else checks corruption with KB acct; signal last-put defers OOM target; mm PGD has active/no-op forms with OOM guard.

locks.text: Handler lock serializes parent notify, group-exit install, lazy group-store publish and group accumulation; notify/accum preserve interrupts, control paths mask them.
Listener walk uses shared lock for clone/deliver and exclusive only for prune; integral refresh masks interrupts; tasklist rw-lock is outermost; mmlist spinlock guards mm list.
Cross-task stability uses task lock for mm sampling, RCU for exe/ids/creds held past section, exec read lock for mm access with ptrace/cap checks, minimal task-lock for cred check and vfork clear.
One mutex serializes fault-injection list/lookup/values; cached stacks use preempt-disabled atomic exchange with RCU-deferred reclaim safe for IRQ.
Exe swap refuses busy under read lock, denies writes, swaps under write lock then releases old; new mm inits mapping rwsem plus seq/waitq and PT/arg/AIO spinlocks.

state_machines.text: Terminal path validates context, repairs IRQ/atomic, bounds repeated faults, diverts recursive exit to dead, else normal exit; group exit reuses installed code, suppresses during exec, else installs code and signals peers.
Exception tables sort main once when flagged and nonempty under dedicated mutex, resolve by kernel then module then accelerator returning first hit.

Injection goes absent-armed-triggered: arm resolves symbol, checks injectable/unique, registers probe and publishes state; trigger probabilistically overrides return; disarm singly by name or fully by blank input.

Vmalloc stacks prefer node-aware per-CPU cache with cgroup/sanitizer handling and clearing, else fresh alloc; release tries cache return else RCU-deferred free; page and slab variants pair alloc with null-clear and RCU reclaim.

Lazy mm revoke switches remote users to init mm with warnings, no-op when disabled; async drop schedules embedded work on last ref; new mm zeroes, inits tree/refs/seq/locks/acct/IO/owner/probes, inherits filter/flags, acquires pgd/id/context/sched with unwind on failure.

Task dup allocates node-local descriptor/stack, copies arch state, sets stack/IPI/shadow, clears sched/notify, freshens refs, inherits affinity/trace/acct with unwind on failure; shadow prefers cleared cache else node alloc; vfork parent sleeps frozen-aware killable; ptrace allows same-group else one cred mode with barrier, dumpable and cap checks.

structs.text: Wire nests id plus stats payload in process/group aggregate with aligned sizing, group exit reserving double; wait result holds pid/uid/status/cause; wait request joins match type, target, flags, out-pointers, status, queue entry and fallback error.
Injection context holds list node, kprobe name/addr and forced result; task caches cover task/mm/stacks and others; vmalloc-stack tracker pairs RCU head with area for deferred free.

Observed task state spans stack/shadow, affinity, refs/RCU, sched/exec/coverage/trace/acct and messaging/filter pointers; mm state spans map tree, refs, seq, lists, PT/RSS acct, locks, cpumask, IO, owner, exe, notify and async work, validated drained at free.

ABI: wait events WEXITED/WSTOPPED/WCONTINUED, mods WNOHANG/WNOWAIT/__WNOTHREAD/__WCLONE/__WALL, scopes P_ALL/PID/PGID/PIDFD; reasons CLD_CONTINUED/STOPPED/TRAPPED under SIGCHLD; acct AXSIG/ACORE/ASU/AFORK/AGROUP; stats CMD_NEW, PID/TGID, AGGR_PID/AGGR_TGID, STATS/NULL, VERSION; exit low-8 code; MIN/MAX_THREADS, NR_CACHED_STACKS, GFP_VMAP_STACK; STACK/SCS_END_MAGIC; RLIMIT_NPROC/SIGPENDING, UCOUNT_MEMLOCK/MSGQUEUE/NPROC/SIGPENDING; MMF_DUMP_FILTER_DEFAULT/SHIFT/MASK, VM_INIT_DEF_MASK; PTRACE_MODE_READ/FSCREDS/REALCREDS/NOAUDIT, CAP_SYS_PTRACE, TASK_DUMPABLE_OWNER; TASK_KILLABLE/FREEZABLE.
